text:
sasha: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for INC-345 — we surfaced a recurring cache-eviction pattern. Need clear owners + timelines for remediation and runbook edits. 15m sync?
maya: Yes please. I can take the cache config recommendations and PR the runbook changes.
liam: I can own the canary rollout to test the changes. ETA 2w for verification unless we find a blocker.
katie-cs: FYI product will need a short note for support once we change TTL behavior. Can we keep a rollback plan?
sasha: @maya assign the runbook edits in the FU epic and add the exact commands we used in the postmortem. @liam add a canary checklist. katie-cs — we should draft the support blurb, 1 paragraph.
maya: Will do. Drafting runbook snippet now. Adding steps and the one-off mitigation commands we ran:
```
# quick triage commands
# check eviction metrics
curl -s http://metrics.internal/evictions | jq .recent
# dump top keys by TTL
redis-cli --raw keys "cache:*" | xargs -n1 redis-cli ttl | sort -nr | head -n 20
```
liam: For rollout: plan to deploy to canary pool (10% capacity), monitor 10m windows for evictions and latency, then grad to 50% after 1 hour if stable. I'll add the exact kubectl commands.
ops-bot: Created ticket INC-345-FU-01 (owner: maya) and INC-345-FU-02 (owner: liam). Links: https://tracker/INC-345-FU-01, https://tracker/INC-345-FU-02 :white_check_mark:
sasha: Ownership confirmed: maya = runbook + config PR, liam = rollout + verification, katie-cs = external comms. Timeline: runbook PR by EOD Thu, canary next Tue, full rollout the following Tue (two-week verification window).
maya: Noted. I'll include the exact config diff in the PR and a short test plan so QA can run it against staging.
liam: If canary shows any spike in 95th latency, we rollback to previous config using this script:
```
# rollback script
kubectl -n infra set image deploy/cache-proxy cache-proxy:stable-20250401
# clear prefixes added by patch
redis-cli del "cache:staging:ttl-experiment"
```
katie-cs: Sounds good. I'll draft the support blurb and ping PM for approval before publishing.
sasha: Also a note for playbook — add an escalation path for repeated evictions: after 2 occurrences in 7 days escalate to oncall-sre + oncall-platform and open a recurring incident review. Add that to the runbook.
maya: Adding escalation steps + sample pager message.
liam: Will add metrics dashboard links and the query thresholds that trigger the escalation.
sasha: Great. Action items recap:
- INC-345-FU-01 (maya) runbook PR + config diff (due EOD Thu)
- INC-345-FU-02 (liam) canary rollout + verification (canary Tue)
- INC-345-FU-03 (katie-cs) support comms blurb (in 3 days)
ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up check-in in 7 days for INC-345-FU-01.
sasha: Thanks all — if no blockers we won't need a meeting, otherwise re-open thread. :spiral_calendar:
